name: Post Chick
author: Samee Ullah Feroz

sections.description:
Post Chick helps WordPress writers remember important content and SEO duties while they write.

The floating chick assistant checks the title, main keyword, introduction, content length, headings, paragraphs, links, images, alt text, questions, conclusion, call to action, and meta description. Completed duties turn green automatically.

Post Chick Free includes local Auto Complete plus optional Gemini and OpenAI generation using an administrator’s own API key.

Features:

  • Floating animated writing assistant
  • Live automatic checklist and green ticks
  • Content-type and main-keyword guidance
  • Word count and content structure checks
  • Internal link, external source, image and alt checks
  • Questions, conclusion, CTA and metadata checks
  • Limited Auto Complete All Rules
  • Linked table of contents
  • Editorial draft protection
  • Authorized administrator override records
  • Local content-quality reports
  • No visitor tracking
  • Built-in How to Use and troubleshooting guidance

Post Chick Pro

Need the premium edition? Post Chick Pro is available separately from PingBooster. Visit the official Post Chick Pro page for its current features, plans, licensing terms, and purchase options.

Post Chick Free remains usable without purchasing Post Chick Pro. The Pro edition is a separate premium product and is not hosted on WordPress.org.

External services

Post Chick can optionally connect to Google Gemini or OpenAI when an administrator enables AI generation, selects a provider, saves an API key, and an editor clicks Auto Complete. The current title, main keyword, content type, and article text are sent to the selected provider to generate a suggested title, article HTML, and meta description. No provider request is made when external AI is disabled.

Google Gemini API: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs
Google terms: https://policies.google.com/terms
Google privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

OpenAI API: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs
OpenAI terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/
OpenAI privacy policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

API availability, free-tier quotas, and charges are controlled by each provider. ChatGPT subscriptions and OpenAI API billing are separate.

Post Chick improves content readiness but cannot guarantee rankings, indexing, traffic, or inclusion in AI-generated answers.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Post Chick plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP through Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate Post Chick.
  3. Configure Post Chick > Settings.
  4. Open a post, page, or product and click the floating chick.
  5. Select the content type and enter the main keyword.
sections.faq:
Does Post Chick guarantee Google rankings?

No. It helps writers improve content structure and completeness, but search engines make their own ranking and indexing decisions.

Does the Free version require an AI API?

No. Local generation works without a key. Gemini and OpenAI are optional and use an administrator’s own API account.

Can I use my ChatGPT Plus subscription as an API key?

No. ChatGPT subscriptions and OpenAI API usage are billed separately. Create an API key in the OpenAI Platform and check its billing settings.

Can an administrator publish despite warnings?

Yes. Authorized roles can record an override reason and accept responsibility for unresolved recommendations.

What should I do if I find a bug?

Please ask the developer in the Post Chick support forum. Include your WordPress version, PHP version, Post Chick version, the steps that reproduce the problem, and any visible error message. Do not post passwords, API keys, license keys, or private customer information.

Where can I learn about Post Chick Pro?

See the official Post Chick Pro page for current premium features, pricing, licensing, and support information.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

  • Replaced short global identifiers with the unique Post Chick prefix.
  • Updated WordPress options, transients, post metadata, asset handles, and JavaScript configuration names.
  • Corrected the WordPress.org contributor username.
  • Retained optional, disclosed Gemini and OpenAI support for WordPress 6.6 and newer.

1.1.1

  • Added a complete How to Use and troubleshooting page.
  • Preserved publishing override roles when saving settings.
  • Prevented an empty supported-content configuration.
  • Completed uninstall cleanup for all Post Chick post metadata.
  • Corrected the dashboard version label and improved translation readiness.

1.1.0

  • Added optional Gemini generation as the recommended AI provider.
  • Added optional OpenAI Responses API generation.
  • Kept the no-cost local generator as an automatic fallback.
  • Added server-side API key handling and external-service disclosure.

1.0.1

  • Fixed Auto Complete on empty posts.
  • Added keyword-based starter title, introduction, headings, FAQs, conclusion, CTA, TOC, and meta description.
  • Improved Gutenberg block insertion.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added floating Post Chick assistant.
  • Added live checks, green ticks, limited Auto Complete, TOC, reports, and publishing gate.
